name: app-oviah-information-architecture-full-sitemap-tree
title: OVIAH 'Making health information easier to navigate' full information-architecture sitemap tree
whatItIs: A dense colour-coded sitemap tree from Application through Login and Register into five main sections (Home, Track, Conditions, Health, Support), each branching into sub-pages and leaf items, plus a separate pink-outlined branch for a floating action button's quick-add options.
whatItMeans: Exhaustive and disciplined; mapping the entire app's structure before UI design prevents missing or orphaned screens.
techniques: Colour-code root, section and leaf nodes differently.
Branch a floating action button's shortcuts as a separate tree.
Map the complete app structure before any screen design begins.

vocabulary.definition: The organisation and structure of an app or site's content.
An end point in a tree diagram with no further children.
